levels.title: Create a scouting table (CREATE + INSERT)
levels.task: Stellar Sound is scouting talent in Austin, Phnom Penh, and Detroit. The practice database is almost empty (top_songs is already there for later lessons). Create table new_artists with name VARCHAR(100), genre VARCHAR(50), city VARCHAR(100), state VARCHAR(100). Insert Luna Ray (Pop, Austin, TX), Sothea (Indie, Phnom Penh, KH), and Blaze Carter (Hip-Hop, Detroit, MI). Your last line must be: SELECT * FROM new_artists ORDER BY name; (This site checks only that last result—same columns and row order as the answer.)
levels.initialCode: -- CREATE TABLE, INSERT three artists, then SELECT * FROM new_artists ORDER BY name;
levels.hintMessage: You can run CREATE and INSERT first, but end with SELECT * FROM new_artists ORDER BY name. Only the last query is checked.
levels.successMessage: Nice! The scouting table is ready for the next open-mic or campus night.

levels.title: Track demo submissions (CREATE + INSERT)
levels.task: Still at Stellar Sound on a fresh database: create demo_songs with song_title VARCHAR(100), artist_name VARCHAR(100), submission_date DATE. Add 'Sunset City' by Luna Ray (2024-06-01) and 'River Lights' by Sothea (2024-06-02). End with: SELECT * FROM demo_songs ORDER BY submission_date; so the row order matches the answer.
levels.initialCode: -- CREATE demo_songs, INSERT two rows, then SELECT * ORDER BY submission_date
levels.hintMessage: Dates look like 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Your last line must be SELECT * FROM demo_songs ORDER BY submission_date (oldest date first).
levels.successMessage: Good! Demos are saved in date order for the listening team.

levels.title: Fix a chart typo (UPDATE)
levels.task: Back on the live chart at Stellar Sound: song id 1003 has a typo—artist reads 'Dua Lipppa' but should be 'Dua Lipa'. Run UPDATE top_songs SET artist = 'Dua Lipa' WHERE id = 1003; then finish with SELECT id, track_name, artist FROM top_songs WHERE id = 1003; (Those three columns, in that order.)
levels.initialCode:
-- UPDATE ... WHERE id = 1003;
-- SELECT id, track_name, artist FROM top_songs WHERE id = 1003;
levels.solution:
UPDATE top_songs SET artist = 'Dua Lipa' WHERE id = 1003;
SELECT id, track_name, artist FROM top_songs WHERE id = 1003;
levels.hintMessage: The last SELECT must show id, track_name, artist for id 1003. The UPDATE line is not checked—only the final table you print.
levels.successMessage: Nice! The name is fixed for fans everywhere.

levels.title: Remove very old songs (DELETE)
levels.task: Stellar Sound is cleaning the export: remove songs released before February 1, 2015. Run DELETE FROM top_songs WHERE release_date < '2015-02-01'; then end with SELECT COUNT(*) AS remaining_songs FROM top_songs; (The count column must be named remaining_songs.)
levels.initialCode:
-- DELETE ...;
-- SELECT COUNT(*) AS remaining_songs FROM top_songs;
levels.solution:
DELETE FROM top_songs WHERE release_date < '2015-02-01';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS remaining_songs FROM top_songs;
levels.hintMessage: Dates are text—use < '2015-02-01'. The last SELECT must name the count remaining_songs.
levels.successMessage: Great! Old rows are gone and the new count matches the answer.

levels.title: Add a new hit (INSERT)
levels.task: A new single just hit the Stellar Sound chart. Insert one row into top_songs: id 1006, track_name 'Espresso', artist 'Sabrina Carpenter', genre 'Pop', release_date '2024-04-12', spotify_streams 2050000000, album_name 'Short n Sweet', duration_ms 175000, weeks_on_chart 1. End with SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE id = 1006; (You should see one new row.)
levels.initialCode:
-- INSERT ... VALUES (...);
-- SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE id = 1006;
levels.solution:
INSERT INTO top_songs (id, track_name, artist, genre, release_date, spotify_streams, album_name, duration_ms, weeks_on_chart) VALUES (1006, 'Espresso', 'Sabrina Carpenter', 'Pop', '2024-04-12', 2050000000, 'Short n Sweet', 175000, 1);
SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE id = 1006;
levels.hintMessage: Put the columns in INSERT in the same order as the lesson answer. Last line: SELECT * ... WHERE id = 1006.
levels.successMessage: Perfect! The new song row is saved in the chart.
